JSON: {"Displayname":"CIPP: Restrict Local Administrators","Description":"Restricts the local Administrators group on Microsoft Entra joined Windows devices (Replace/Restrict action). Members kept: the built-in Administrator account under the name Windows LAPS automatic account management gives it (WLapsAdmin; requires Windows 11 24H2 or later), the Bezalu local service account, and the tenant's Global Administrator and Microsoft Entra Joined Device Local Administrator role SIDs, which CIPP fills in per tenant at deployment so that technicians can still elevate through PIM. Every other member is removed, including the user who joined the device. Assign only after LAPS has renamed the built-in account: until then WLapsAdmin does not resolve and Windows reports 0x55b (it refuses to remove the built-in account, so no access is lost). Pilot before broad assignment.
